answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using collateralized slashing bonds locked in an on-chain escrow. To participate, an agent must cross a financial ridge by depositing locked stake, authoring state updates with its cryptographic quill. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating scarce liquid capital per identity. Although this barrier stops fake swarms before they reach a consensus summit, the mechanism penalizes underfunded honest agents.
